analysis_notes.torah_structure_note: Torah LM2 #105 is a very brief oral teaching (4 lines), transmitted by Reb Nosson. Its argument is: (1) Rebbe Nachman urged people to innovate in Torah; (2) even if you cannot grasp his intent, any innovation is good; (3) it is a great tikkun for hirhurim (sinful thoughts); (4) because all hirhurim come from koach hamedameh (the imaginative faculty), and chiddush in Torah — which is itself a bechina of medame milta l'milta — repairs the damage done by that same faculty; (5) it is also a benefit for the souls of one's departed ancestors.
